description: This PHP source file defines the CRMEntity base class for the vtiger CRM system, providing core functionalities for managing CRM data entities such as creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and managing related records. It includes methods for database interaction, security, event triggering, and module-specific operations. The file sets the foundation for all module data handling within the application.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Base class providing core CRM entity management functionalities such as CRUD operations, relation management, event triggering, security, and module-specific logic within the vtiger CRM platform. Acts as a parent class for module-specific entities, facilitating database interactions and business logic encapsulation.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Fetch entity data from the database for a given record ID and module, populating the column_fields array with retrieved data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Coordinates pre-save events and calls saveentity() to persist the entity data into the database, handling business logic and event hooks.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Marks a record as deleted by setting the 'deleted' flag in the database for the specified ID.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores a previously deleted record and triggers related events and dependent record restorations.

methods.name: get_attachments
methods.description: Retrieves related attachment records for the specified entity, supporting related list display.

methods.name: __timediff
methods.description: Calculates the difference in seconds between two datetime strings.

methods.name: saveentity
methods.description: Handles the detailed process of saving an entity, including database inserts/updates, managing entity relations, and handling bulk modes.

methods.name: insertIntoCrmEntity
methods.description: Inserts or updates core entity information in the vtiger_crmentity table, managing ownership, description, and timestamps.

methods.name: insertIntoEntityTable
methods.description: Inserts or updates module-specific entity data into corresponding database tables.

methods.name: deleteRelation
methods.description: Deletes the entity's data from a specified relation table.

methods.name: uploadAndSaveFile
methods.description: Uploads a file to the server and saves the associated attachment data into the database.

methods.name: checkIfCustomTableExists
methods.description: Checks if a given custom table exists in the database.

methods.name: constructCustomQueryAddendum
methods.description: Constructs additional SQL query parts for fetching custom fields.

methods.name: get_full_list
methods.description: Returns a full list of entities of this type, optionally ordered and filtered.

methods.name: process_list_query
methods.description: Executes a paginated query and returns a processed list of entity objects.

methods.name: initSortByField
methods.description: Initializes the list of fields available for sorting.

methods.name: delete_related_module
methods.description: Deletes relationships between the current record and related module records, supporting specific handling for 'Documents' module.

methods.name: get_related_list
methods.description: Fetches related records for a given entity, constructing dynamic SQL queries and preparing UI buttons for actions like select and add.

methods.name: get_dependents_list
methods.description: Retrieves dependent records related via UI type '10' reference fields, constructing appropriate query joins.

methods.name: transferRelatedRecords
methods.description: Transfers related records from multiple source records to a target record, updating relation mappings.

methods.name: generateReportsQuery
methods.description: Constructs the main SQL query for report data retrieval for a primary module, including joins on custom fields and relations.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Builds secondary report query parts for related modules, including relation and security filters.

methods.name: getListViewSecurityParameter
methods.description: Generates the security filter SQL for list views based on user permissions.

methods.name: getSecListViewSecurityParameter
methods.description: Generates security filter conditions for secondary module list views.

methods.name: getRelationQuery
methods.description: Creates the SQL join clause to relate primary and secondary modules, based on relation tables.

methods.name: add_related_to
methods.description: Links or creates related records in referenced modules based on input data.

methods.name: filterInactiveFields
methods.description: Filters out inactive or non-visible fields from list and search configurations to streamline UI.

methods.name: buildSearchQueryForFieldTypes
methods.description: Builds dynamic search SQL queries for fields of specified UI types.

methods.name: getJoinClause
methods.description: Determines whether to use INNER JOIN or LEFT JOIN based on table name.

methods.name: getNonAdminAccessQuery
methods.description: Constructs a union SQL query to give non-admin users access to data based on roles and sharing rules.

methods.name: getNonAdminUserAccessQuery
methods.description: Generates SQL sub-query for user-specific access based on role hierarchy.

methods.name: getNonAdminModuleAccessQuery
methods.description: Constructs module-level sharing access SQL based on sharing privileges.

methods.name: setupTemporaryTable
methods.description: Creates temporary tables to facilitate scoped access for non-admin users.

methods.name: getNonAdminAccessControlQuery
methods.description: Generates the SQL join clause for access control filtering in list views.

methods.name: listQueryNonAdminChange
methods.description: Adjusts main list query to ensure proper filtering and performance optimization.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Returns relation table info for related modules, supporting specific relationships like Documents.

methods.name: clearSingletonSaveFields
methods.description: Placeholder for resetting fields that should be saved only once; currently empty.

methods.name: trackLinkedInfo
methods.description: Updates modification timestamp when a record is linked to another.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the sorting order ('ASC' or 'DESC') for list views based on request/session.

methods.name: getOrderBy
methods.description: Retrieves the field name to order list views, considering defaults and session settings.

methods.name: getListButtons
methods.description: Determines list view action buttons based on user permissions, e.g., delete and mass edit.

methods.name: trackUnLinkedInfo
methods.description: Updates modification timestamp when unlinking relationships.
